name: Published Referenced Entity
description: Field formatters that display a referenced entity only when it is published (a display-layer publish filter, not access control).
project_description:
The Published referenced entity is a drupal module that implement the specialized display format for fields that reference other entities. In Drupal, entities are a fundamental concept and can represent various types of content, such as nodes, users, taxonomy terms, etc.

 By default, Drupal provides a set of field formatters for different field types. However, in certain cases, you may want to display only published entities or active users for fields that reference entities. 

 The module provides an administrative interface where you can configure the settings for the field formatter. Once the module is enabled, you would be able to select the field formatter for referenced entity fields on the Manage Display configuration page of the entity type to which the field belongs. If you have referenced entities that are not published, they will not be displayed when rendering the entity reference field. This module provides the following formatters for the nodes, users and taxonomy terms referenced entity field:

 
 Published Entity ID 
 Published Entity Label 
 Published Rendered Entity 
 
 How to use this module: 

 
 Enable the Published referenced entity module: 
 Go to the Extend page (/admin/modules) in your Drupal site. 
 Find the "Published referenced entity" module in the list and enable it. 
 Click the "Save configuration" button to apply the changes. 
 Go to the Manage Fields page for your content type: 
 Navigate to the Content Type configuration page for the content type where you want to add instructions to a field. 
 Add the referenced field for the node, user or taxonomy term entities 
 Click on the "Manage fields" tab for that content type. 
 Edit the field and configure the formatter. Select the Published Entity ID or Published Entity Label or Published Rendered Entity formatter and other configurations. 
 Click the "Save" button to save the field configuration after updating the formatters. 
 After making these changes, the referenced entities will not be rendered and displayed if they are not published or active.
